description: LeakG3PD provides simulated water-distribution measurements and a Python generator for leakage-detection benchmarks. Matheus Pilotto and contributors developed it as an extension of LeakDB. The public data folder contains archives for the Hanoi, Net1 and Net3 benchmark networks. Leaks are inserted at new nodes along randomly selected pipes, with pressure-dependent leakage and altered demand patterns. Scenario zero has no leaks. Measurements are grouped by physical variable in CSV files. These are synthetic network scenarios, not measurements of a currently operating city network. The inspected documentation does not establish an observation period or a common sampling interval for all archives. GitHub provides the generator under EUPL-1.2, and the linked Drive archives are publicly accessible without payment. A separate licence statement for those archives was not found. The generator depends on WNTR, catalogued as model-wntr. Simulation uses include testing leakage detection and localisation under controlled hydraulic conditions. Compared with data-leakdb, this resource changes leakage placement and demand construction. Detection performance on these simulations does not establish performance on operational sensor data.
licence: EUPL-1.2 for repository; separate licence for linked data archives not stated
